lead.headline: Samford wins at Georgia Tech, and the SoCon goes 18-5
lead.deck: The Bulldogs covered as 10.5-point underdogs on the road. Tennessee Tech scored 124 and climbed to second.
body: Samford went to Georgia Tech as a 10.5-point underdog and won 92-81. Cooper Noard had 24 points, eight rebounds and three assists, and Cade Norris added 20 points, six rebounds and six assists. Two nights earlier the Bulldogs had needed everything to beat UNC Asheville 80-77 as 10.5-point favorites. Same spread, opposite direction, better result.
That win led an 18-5 week for the league, the best record of any conference in this morning's group. The lines were less impressed: SoCon teams covered nine of 20.

Tennessee Tech is 6-2 and 108th in our model, the best rating in the league at plus-6.7 points per 100 possessions. The Golden Eagles beat Presbyterian 97-69 and then West Georgia 124-85, covering 14.5 by 24.5. Trent Mosquera scored 25 and Davante Hackett had 22 points and nine rebounds. The power rankings moved them from sixth to second.

Furman is 7-1 and still first in the power rankings. The Paladins beat Clinton 108-69 and Elon 82-60 as 7.5-point favorites, with Charles Johnston scoring 21. They are 114th in our model, second in the league.

The standings and the model disagree loudly about two teams. The Citadel is 5-2 and VMI is 5-3, third and fourth in the standings. Our model has them 304th and 305th, the bottom two in the league. The Citadel beat South Carolina State 79-63 and USC Upstate 72-54. VMI beat Gardner-Webb 71-68 and Southern Indiana 87-83, and didn't cover either line. Conference play starts Tuesday, and VMI hosts it.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three tests before the league opener
body: **Tennessee Tech at Eastern Kentucky, Saturday, 4 p.m.** No line yet. The league's top-rated team on the road, then at Middle Tennessee on Tuesday. Two road games in four days will say whether 124 points was a habit or a night.
**Furman at Troy, Tuesday, 7 p.m.** No line yet. Troy comes to Chattanooga on Saturday first, so the Mocs get a look before the Paladins do.
**Samford at UAB, Wednesday, 7:30 p.m.** No line yet. The Bulldogs just won at Georgia Tech. Another road win over a bigger name would make it a habit.

notes.headline: Watley named Player of the Week
notes.body: Wofford's Chace Watley scored 29 in a 91-86 win over Winthrop and was named SoCon Player of the Week, per soconsports.com. The Terriers also beat Queens 86-77 as 1-point underdogs, with Cutter Sisk going for 22 points, nine rebounds and four assists.

notes.headline: Rickey Bradley Jr.'s week
notes.body: VMI's guard scored 21 against Gardner-Webb and 27 against Southern Indiana. Both games were wins, both by three or four.

notes.headline: Chattanooga stumbles at home
notes.body: The Mocs lost 73-65 at home to Radford as 7.5-point favorites, then beat Delaware State 79-66 as 16.5-point favorites without covering.

notes.headline: Circle it: UNC Greensboro at VMI
notes.body: Tuesday, 6 p.m. ET on ESPN+, the first league game of the season. No line posted yet; our model has VMI by 2.9.
